items.headline: Lazy gas, hot gas, and a thousand robots
items.excerpt: Viewing multirobot motion planning as an optimal-transport problem and using a Schrödinger bridge to approximate solutions enables near-optimal routing at fulfillment-center scale.

items.headline: Mathematical proof, powered by AI. And no hallucinations!
items.excerpt: With new tools that make it easier to check mathematical proofs — even as they’re being constructed — AI is becoming a valuable partner in mathematical discovery.
